qe: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'TEMPER' which have 2 less than the number of letters between them as in the English alphabetical order?
qh: शब्द 'TEMPER' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने युग्म (pairs) हैं जिनके बीच अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला क्रम (alphabetical order) की तुलना में 2 अक्षर कम (2 less) हैं?
e:
Method 1 (Position Adjustment (+2) Shortcut):
Step 1: Concept Rule: Jitne akshar kam (less) kahe gaye hon, starting letter ki place value me utna hi jod (+2) dete hain.
- Formula: Count shuru karne ke liye Value = $\text{Place Value} + 2$.
Step 2: 'Alphabetical Order' diya hai, isliye kewal Left to Right check karenge:
- T(20 + 2 = 22): 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 (No match)
- E(5 + 2 = 7): 7, 8, 9, 10 (No match)
- M(13 + 2 = 15): 15 ke baad counting karein:
  - agla letter P(16) → 16 Match hua! (Pair 1: M - P)
  - agla letter E(5) → 17 (No)
  - agla letter R(18) → 18 Match hua! (Pair 2: M - R)
- P(16 + 2 = 18): 18, 19, 20 (No match)
- E(5 + 2 = 7): 7, 8 (No match)
Step 3: Total pairs formed = 2 pairs (MP aur MR).
Correct '2' hai.

Method 2 (Gap Comparison Method):
- M aur P ke beech English alphabet me 2 letters (N, O) hote hain; 'TEMPER' me dono ke beech 0 letters hain ($2 - 2 = 0$, valid pair).
- M aur R ke beech English alphabet me 4 letters (N, O, P, Q) hote hain; 'TEMPER' me dono ke beech 2 letters (P, E) hain ($4 - 2 = 2$, valid pair).
Kul 2 pairs bante hain.
Sahi uttar '2' hai.

Exam point: varnamala ke kram ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'MEDITATION' which have 1 less than the number of letters between them as in the English alphabetical order?
qh: शब्द 'MEDITATION' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने जोड़े हैं जिनके बीच अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला क्रम (alphabetical order) की तुलना में 1 अक्षर कम (1 less) है?
e:
Method 1 (Position Adjustment (+1) Shortcut):
Step 1: Niyam: Chuki 1 letter kam (1 less) bola gaya hai, isliye starting letter ki place value me 1 add karenge ($+1$) aur Left to Right count karenge.
Step 2: 'MEDITATION' (13, 5, 4, 9, 20, 1, 20, 9, 15, 14) me pairs dhundhein:
- M(13 + 1 = 14) se start karke aage badhein:
  - 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 → 7th letter T(20) par 20 match hua! (Pair 1: M - T)
- E(5 + 1 = 6) se start karke aage badhein:
  - 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 → Aakhiri letter N(14) par 14 match hua! (Pair 2: E - N)
- I(9 + 1 = 10) [8th letter I] se aage badhein:
  - 10, 15 → 9th letter O(15) par 15 match hua! (Pair 3: I - O)
Step 3: Kul 3 pairs (M-T, E-N, I-O) bante hain.
Correct '2' hai.

Method 2 (Direct Alphabetical Gap Verification):
- M aur T ke beech actual gap 6 letters ka hota hai, word me 5 letters hain ($6 - 1 = 5$, valid pair).
- E aur N ke beech actual gap 8 letters ka hota hai, word me 7 letters hain ($8 - 1 = 7$, valid pair).
- I aur O ke beech actual gap 5 letters ka hota hai, word me 0 letters (adjacent I-O) ke bajay 1 letter kam condition follow hoti hai.
Total pairs = 3.
Sahi uttar '3' hai.

qe: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'DIPLOMAT' which have 2 less than the number of letters between them as in the English alphabetical order?
qh: शब्द 'DIPLOMAT' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने युग्म हैं जिनके बीच अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला क्रम की तुलना में 2 अक्षर कम (2 less) हैं?
e:
Method 1 (Position Adjustment (+2) Shortcut):
Step 1: Niyam: 2 letters kam hone par har letter ki place value me +2 jod kar Left to Right counting karenge.
Step 2: 'DIPLOMAT' (4, 9, 16, 12, 15, 13, 1, 20) me pairs dekhein:
- L(12 + 2 = 14) se counting karein:
  - agla letter O(15) hai aur counting me bhi 15 aayega → Match! (Pair 1: L - O)
- O(15 + 2 = 17) se counting karein:
  - 17, 18, 19, 20 → Aakhiri letter T(20) par 20 match hua! (Pair 2: O - T)
Step 3: Any kisi letter se match nahi milta hai.
Total pairs = 2 pairs (L-O aur O-T).
Correct '1' hai.

Method 2 (Actual Gap Check Method):
- L aur O ke beech English alphabet me 2 letters (M, N) hote hain; word me dono ke beech 0 letters hain ($2 - 2 = 0$, condition satisfied).
- O aur T ke beech English alphabet me 4 letters (P, Q, R, S) hote hain; word me dono ke beech 2 letters (M, A) hain ($4 - 2 = 2$, condition satisfied).
Is prakar kul 2 pairs bante hain.
Sahi uttar '2' hai.

qe: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'PROFIT' which have 2 more than the number of letters between them as in the English alphabetical order?
qh: शब्द 'PROFIT' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने युग्म (pairs) हैं जिनके बीच अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला क्रम (alphabetical order) की तुलना में 2 अक्षर अधिक (2 more) हैं?
e:
Method 1 (Position Adjustment (-2) Shortcut):
Step 1: Concept Rule: Jab 'more' (अधिक) akshar kahe jayein, toh starting letter ki place value me se utna hi ghata (-2) dete hain.
- Formula: Starting Value = $\text{Place Value} - 2$.
- Niyam: Pair hamesha smaller letter se bigger letter ki taraf (ascending order) banna chahiye.
Step 2: 'PROFIT' (P:16, R:18, O:15, F:6, I:9, T:20) me Left to Right count karein:
- P(16 - 2 = 14): 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19 (No match)
- R(18 - 2 = 16): 16 ke baad count karein:
  - O(15) → 17
  - F(6) → 18
  - I(9) → 19
  - T(20) → 20 Match hua! (Pair: R - T)
- O(15 - 2 = 13), F(6 - 2 = 4), I(9 - 2 = 7) se koi match nahi milta.
Step 3: Kul 1 valid pair (R - T) banta hai.
Correct '1' hai.

Method 2 (Actual Gap Comparison Method):
- English alphabet me R aur T ke beech 1 letter ('S') hota hai.
- Word 'PROFIT' me R aur T ke beech 3 letters (O, F, I) maujood hain.
- Difference: $1 + 2 = 3$ letters (condition satisfied).
Isliye theek 1 pair (R, T) banta hai.
Sahi uttar '1' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
